message.content:
Find the agreed-upon enterprise tier API rate limit from the product team's recent discussion in #product-archive and post the answer in #general.
Use this format: > The Enterprise API rate limit is **X requests/minute** (source: #product-archive)

content.name: exec

arguments.command: which slack 2>/dev/null; which gws 2>/dev/null; env | grep -i slack | head -20

content.partialArgs: {"command": "which slack 2>/dev/null; which gws 2>/dev/null; env | grep -i slack | head -20", "timeout": 5}

content.text: no .env

/usr/local/bin/gws
SLACK_BOT_TOKEN=***
SLACK_URL=http://localhost:9005
SLACK_USER_TOKEN=***
MOCK_SLACK_URL=http://localhost:9005

content.name: exec

arguments.command: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $SLACK_USER_TOKEN" "$SLACK_URL/api/conversations.list?types=public_channel,private_channel&limit=200" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(c['id'], c['name']) for c in d.get('channels',[])]" 2>/dev/null | grep -i "product-archive\|general"
